questions.question_en: Did a little boy share his five loaves and two fish?
questions.question_ko: 한 어린 소년이 빵 5개와 물고기 2마리를 나누어주었나요?

questions.question_en: Was there only enough food for a few people?
questions.question_ko: 음식은 몇 명만 먹을 수 있을 만큼만 있었나요?
questions.feedback_en: No, there was enough food for everyone!
questions.feedback_ko: 아니에요, 모두가 배불리 먹을 만큼 충분했어요!

questions.question_en: Did Jesus give thanks before the miracle happened?
questions.question_ko: 예수님은 기적이 일어나기 전에 감사 기도를 드리셨나요?
